description: Na₂Cd(SO₄)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.93 Å. Cd is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted CdO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Cd-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.43 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent CdO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-68°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.49-1.51 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Cd, and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Cd, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Cd, and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and one S atom.
